drivingQuestion: May years be intercalated and months fixed outside Eretz Yisrael, and how far may the Sages of the Land go to prevent it?
outcomeNote: The Babylonian community submits and calendrical authority stays with Eretz Yisrael; the closing difficulty about the scholars' lenient reversals is answered by the exigency of the hour.

segments.he: תַּנְיָא, רַבִּי אוֹמֵר: לְעוֹלָם אַל יַרְבֶּה אָדָם רֵעִים בְּתוֹךְ בֵּיתוֹ, שֶׁנֶּאֱמַר: ״אִישׁ רֵעִים לְהִתְרוֹעֵעַ״.
segments.en: Several ethical tenets and guidelines for life «were taught» in a baraita. «Rabbi» Yehuda HaNasi «says: One should never have too many friends in his house,» i.e., people should not become accustomed to being overly intimate in his house, «as it is stated: “There are friends that one has to his own hurt”» (Proverbs 18:24); one with friends of that kind will ultimately come to quarrel.

segments.he: תַּנְיָא, רַבִּי אוֹמֵר: אַל יְמַנֶּה אָדָם אַפֹּטְרוֹפּוֹס בְּתוֹךְ בֵּיתוֹ, שֶׁאִלְמָלֵי לֹא מִינָּה פּוֹטִיפַר אֶת יוֹסֵף אַפֹּטְרוֹפּוֹס בְּתוֹךְ בֵּיתוֹ — לֹא בָּא לְאוֹתוֹ דָּבָר.
segments.en: «It was taught» in a baraita that «Rabbi» Yehuda HaNasi «says: Do not appoint an administrator [apitropos] within your house, as had Potiphar not appointed Joseph as administrator within his house,» Joseph «would not have come to that incident» involving him in allegations of sexual impropriety.

segments.he: תַּנְיָא, רַבִּי אוֹמֵר: לָמָּה נִסְמְכָה פָּרָשַׁת נָזִיר לְפָרָשַׁת סוֹטָה — לוֹמַר לָךְ שֶׁכָּל הָרוֹאֶה סוֹטָה בְּקִלְקוּלָהּ יַזִּיר עַצְמוֹ מִן הַיַּיִן.
segments.en: «It was taught» in a baraita, «Rabbi» Yehuda HaNasi «says: Why is the portion of the Nazirite» (Numbers ch. 6) «juxtaposed with the portion of the sota» (Numbers ch. 5)? They are juxtaposed «to tell you that anyone who sees a sota in her disgrace,» her transgression, «should renounce wine,» as wine is one of the causes of that transgression.

segments.he: אָמַר חִזְקִיָּה בְּרֵיהּ דְּרַבִּי פַּרְנָךְ אָמַר רַבִּי יוֹחָנָן: לָמָּה נִסְמְכָה פָּרָשַׁת סוֹטָה לְפָרָשַׁת תְּרוּמוֹת וּמַעַשְׂרוֹת — לוֹמַר לָךְ: כֹּל שֶׁיֵּשׁ לוֹ תְּרוּמוֹת וּמַעַשְׂרוֹת וְאֵינוֹ נוֹתְנָן לַכֹּהֵן, סוֹף נִצְרָךְ לַכֹּהֵן עַל יְדֵי אִשְׁתּוֹ, שֶׁנֶּאֱמַר: ״וְאִישׁ אֶת קֳדָשָׁיו לוֹ יִהְיוּ״, וּסְמִיךְ לֵיהּ ״אִישׁ אִישׁ כִּי תִשְׂטֶה אִשְׁתּוֹ״, וּכְתִיב ״וְהֵבִיא הָאִישׁ אֶת אִשְׁתּוֹ״ וְגוֹ׳. וְלֹא עוֹד אֶלָּא סוֹף שֶׁנִּצְרָךְ לָהֶן, שֶׁנֶּאֱמַר: ״וְאִישׁ אֶת קֳדָשָׁיו לוֹ יִהְיוּ״.
segments.en: «Ḥizkiya, son of Rabbi Parnakh, said» that «Rabbi Yoḥanan said: Why is the portion of sota juxtaposed with the portion of terumot and tithes» (Numbers ch. 5)? They are juxtaposed «to tell you: Anyone who has terumot and tithes and does not give them to a priest,» will «ultimately require» the services of «a priest by means of his wife, as it is stated: “And every man’s hallowed things shall be his” (»Numbers 5:10). This refers to one who keeps those hallowed items for himself. «To this» the Torah «juxtaposed: “If any man’s wife go aside and act unfaithfully against him”» (Numbers 5:12). «And it is written: “Then shall the man bring his wife unto the priest”» (Numbers 5:15). «Moreover, ultimately» that man «will require» assistance from the tithe given to the poor, «as it is stated: “And every man’s hallowed things shall be his”» (Numbers 5:10). He will himself need those very hallowed items that he was unwilling to give to others.

segments.he: אָמַר רַב נַחְמָן בַּר יִצְחָק: וְאִם נְתָנָן, סוֹף מִתְעַשֵּׁר, שֶׁנֶּאֱמַר: ״אִישׁ אֲשֶׁר יִתֵּן לַכֹּהֵן לוֹ יִהְיֶה״, ״לוֹ יִהְיֶה״ — מָמוֹן הַרְבֵּה.
segments.en: «Rav Naḥman bar Yitzḥak said: And if he gave them, ultimately» he will «become wealthy, as it is said: “Whatsoever any man gives the priest, it shall be his”» (Numbers 5:10); «much property shall be his.»

segments.he: אָמַר רַב הוּנָא בַּר בֶּרֶכְיָה מִשּׁוּם רַבִּי אֶלְעָזָר הַקַּפָּר: כׇּל הַמְשַׁתֵּף שֵׁם שָׁמַיִם בְּצַעֲרוֹ — כּוֹפְלִין לוֹ פַּרְנָסָתוֹ. שֶׁנֶּאֱמַר: ״וְהָיָה שַׁדַּי בְּצָרֶיךָ וְכֶסֶף תּוֹעָפוֹת לָךְ״.
segments.en: «Rav Huna bar Berekhya said in the name of Rabbi Elazar HaKappar: Anyone who includes the name of heaven in his distress,» i.e., who turns and prays to God in his time of trouble, «his livelihood will» ultimately «be doubled, as it is stated: “And the Almighty be your treasure, and precious [toafot] silver unto you”» (Job 22:25). If you include God in your trouble, your silver will be doubled. Eif, which in Aramaic means double, is etymologically similar to toafot.

segments.he: רַבִּי שְׁמוּאֵל בַּר נַחְמָנִי אָמַר: פַּרְנָסָתוֹ מְעוֹפֶפֶת לוֹ כְּצִפּוֹר, שֶׁנֶּאֱמַר: ״וְכֶסֶף תּוֹעָפוֹת לָךְ״.
segments.en: «Rabbi Shmuel bar Naḥmani said» a different explanation: This means that «his sustenance flies [meofefet] to him like a bird, as it is stated: “And precious silver [toafot] unto you.”»

segments.he: אָמַר רַבִּי טָבִי אָמַר רַבִּי יֹאשִׁיָּה: כׇּל הַמַּרְפֶּה עַצְמוֹ מִדִּבְרֵי תוֹרָה, אֵין בּוֹ כֹּחַ לַעֲמוֹד בְּיוֹם צָרָה, שֶׁנֶּאֱמַר: ״הִתְרַפִּיתָ בְּיוֹם צָרָה צַר כֹּחֶכָה״. אָמַר רַב אַמֵּי בַּר מַתְנָה אָמַר שְׁמוּאֵל: וַאֲפִילּוּ מִצְוָה אַחַת, שֶׁנֶּאֱמַר ״הִתְרַפִּיתָ״ — מִכׇּל מָקוֹם.
segments.en: «Rabbi Tavi said in the name of Rabbi Yoshiya: Anyone who is lax in his» study of «matters of Torah will» ultimately «lack the strength to stand on a day of adversity, as it is stated: “If you faint in the day of adversity, your strength is small indeed”» (Proverbs 24:10). «Rav Ami bar Mattana said» that «Shmuel said: And even» if he was lax in the performance of «a single» mitzva, «as it is stated: If you faint;» this applies «in any case,» even in the case of a single mitzva.

segments.he: אָמַר רַב סָפְרָא: רַבִּי אֲבָהוּ הֲוָה מִשְׁתַּעֵי: כְּשֶׁיָּרַד חֲנִינָא בֶּן אֲחִי רַבִּי יְהוֹשֻׁעַ לַגּוֹלָה, הָיָה מְעַבֵּר שָׁנִים וְקוֹבֵעַ חֳדָשִׁים בְּחוּצָה לָאָרֶץ.
segments.en: «Rav Safra said: Rabbi Abbahu would relate: When Ḥanina, son of Rabbi Yehoshua’s brother, went to the Diaspora,» Babylonia, «he would intercalate years and establish months outside of Eretz» Yisrael. Because Judaism in Eretz Yisrael had declined in the wake of the bar Kokheva rebellion, he considered it necessary to cultivate the Jewish community in Babylonia as the center of the Jewish people. Among other things, he intercalated the years and established the months even though the halakha restricts those activities to Eretz Yisrael.

segments.he: שִׁגְּרוּ אַחֲרָיו שְׁנֵי תַּלְמִידֵי חֲכָמִים, רַבִּי יוֹסֵי בֶּן כִּיפָּר, וּבֶן בְּנוֹ שֶׁל זְכַרְיָה בֶּן קְבוּטָל. כֵּיוָן שֶׁרָאָה אוֹתָם, אָמַר לָהֶם: לָמָּה בָּאתֶם? אָמְרוּ לוֹ: לִלְמוֹד תּוֹרָה בָּאנוּ. הִכְרִיז עֲלֵיהֶם: אֲנָשִׁים הַלָּלוּ גְּדוֹלֵי הַדּוֹר הֵם וַאֲבוֹתֵיהֶם שִׁמְּשׁוּ בְּבֵית הַמִּקְדָּשׁ. כְּאוֹתָהּ שֶׁשָּׁנִינוּ: זְכַרְיָה בֶּן קְבוּטָל אוֹמֵר: הַרְבֵּה פְּעָמִים קָרִיתִי לְפָנָיו, בְּסֵפֶר דָּנִיאֵל.
segments.en: Eventually, the Sages of Eretz Yisrael «sent two Torah scholars after him, Rabbi Yosei ben Keifar and the grandson of Zekharya ben Kevutal. When» Ḥanina «saw them, he asked them: Why did you come? They responded: We came to study Torah.» Since he saw his standing enhanced by the Sages of Eretz Yisrael coming to study Torah from him, «he proclaimed about them: These people are eminent» scholars «of our generation, and their fathers served in the Temple. As we learned» in tractate Yoma: «Zekharya ben Kevutal says: Many times I read before» the High Priest from «the book of Daniel» on the eve of Yom Kippur.

segments.he: הִתְחִיל הוּא מְטַמֵּא וְהֵם מְטַהֲרִים, הוּא אוֹסֵר וְהֵם מַתִּירִים. הִכְרִיז עֲלֵיהֶם: אֲנָשִׁים הַלָּלוּ שֶׁל שָׁוְא הֵם, שֶׁל תֹּהוּ הֵם. אָמְרוּ לוֹ: כְּבָר בָּנִיתָ וְאִי אַתָּה יָכוֹל לִסְתּוֹר, כְּבָר גָּדַרְתָּ וְאִי אַתָּה יָכוֹל לִפְרוֹץ.
segments.en: These two scholars, however, began to dispute every decision Ḥanina rendered in response to questions raised in the study hall. «He» ruled it «impure and they» ruled it «pure; he prohibited» it «and they permitted» it. Eventually, «he proclaimed about them: These people are worthless. They are» good «for nothing» and they know nothing. «They said to him: You have already built» up our names and glorified us; «you cannot now demolish. You have already built a fence and you cannot break through it.»

segments.he: אָמַר לָהֶם: מִפְּנֵי מָה אֲנִי מְטַמֵּא וְאַתֶּם מְטַהֲרִים, אֲנִי אוֹסֵר וְאַתֶּם מַתִּירִים? אָמְרוּ לוֹ: מִפְּנֵי שֶׁאַתָּה מְעַבֵּר שָׁנִים וְקוֹבֵעַ חֳדָשִׁים בְּחוּץ לָאָרֶץ.
segments.en: «He said to them: Why is it that» when «I» rule something «impure, you» rule it «pure;» when «I prohibit» it, «you permit» it? «They said to him:» We do this «because you intercalate the years and establish the months outside of Eretz» Yisrael.

segments.he: אָמַר לָהֶם: וַהֲלֹא עֲקִיבָא בֶּן יוֹסֵף, הָיָה מְעַבֵּר שָׁנִים וְקוֹבֵעַ חֳדָשִׁים בְּחוּץ לָאָרֶץ! אָמְרוּ לוֹ: הַנַּח רַבִּי עֲקִיבָא, שֶׁלֹּא הִנִּיחַ כְּמוֹתוֹ בְּאֶרֶץ יִשְׂרָאֵל. אָמַר לָהֶם: אַף אֲנִי לֹא הִנַּחְתִּי כְּמוֹתִי בְּאֶרֶץ יִשְׂרָאֵל. אָמְרוּ לוֹ: גְּדָיִים שֶׁהִנַּחְתָּ נַעֲשׂוּ תְּיָשִׁים בַּעֲלֵי קַרְנַיִם, וְהֵם שִׁגְּרוּנוּ אֶצְלְךָ, וְכֵן אָמְרוּ לָנוּ: לְכוּ וְאִמְרוּ לוֹ בִּשְׁמֵנוּ: אִם שׁוֹמֵעַ — מוּטָב, וְאִם לָאו — יְהֵא בְּנִדּוּי.
segments.en: «He said to them: Didn’t» Rabbi «Akiva ben Yosef» also «intercalate years and establish months outside of Eretz» Yisrael? «They replied to him: Leave» the case of «Rabbi Akiva, as,» when he left, «he did not leave behind anyone» as great in Torah «as he in Eretz Yisrael.» Rabbi Ḥanina «said to them: I also did not leave behind anyone» as great «as me in Eretz Yisrael. They said to him: The kids who you left behind have grown into goats with horns;» they are greater than you are. «And they sent us to you, and this is what they said to us: Go and tell him in our name: If he obeys, fine; and if» he does «not» obey, «he will be ostracized.»

segments.he: וְאִמְרוּ לְאַחֵינוּ שֶׁבַּגּוֹלָה: אִם שׁוֹמְעִין — מוּטָב, וְאִם לָאו, יַעֲלוּ לְהַר, אֲחִיָּה יִבְנֶה מִזְבֵּחַ, חֲנַנְיָה יְנַגֵּן בְּכִנּוֹר, וְיִכְפְּרוּ כּוּלָּם, וְיֹאמְרוּ אֵין לָהֶם חֵלֶק בֵּאלֹהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל.
segments.en: «And» in order to underscore this, «tell our brethren in exile: If they obey» the Sages of Eretz Yisrael to excommunicate Ḥanina, «fine; and if» they do «not» obey us, it is as if they are seceding from the Jewish people. «They should climb a mountain; Aḥiya,» one of the leaders of the Babylonian Jewish community, «will build an altar, Ḥananya,» son of Rabbi Yehoshua’s brother, who was a Levite, «will play the lute, and all will» proclaim «heresy and say that they have no portion in the God of Israel.»

segments.he: מִיָּד גָּעוּ כׇּל הָעָם בִּבְכִיָּה וְאָמְרוּ: חַס וְשָׁלוֹם, יֵשׁ לָנוּ חֵלֶק בֵּאלֹהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל.
segments.en: This message had a profound impact on the people, and «immediately the entire nation burst into tears, saying: God forbid. We do have a portion in the God of Israel.» They reconsidered their plans to establish Babylonia as the center of the Jewish people.

segments.he: וְכׇל כָּךְ לָמָּה? מִשּׁוּם שֶׁנֶּאֱמַר: ״כִּי מִצִּיּוֹן תֵּצֵא תוֹרָה וּדְבַר ה׳ מִירוּשָׁלָיִם״.
segments.en: The Gemara asks: «Why» did the Sages of Eretz Yisrael go «to that extent» to stop Ḥanina? The Gemara answers: «Because it is stated: “For out of Zion shall go forth the Torah, and the word of the Lord from Jerusalem”» (Isaiah 2:3).

segments.he: בִּשְׁלָמָא הוּא מְטַהֵר, וְהֵם מְטַמְּאִין — לְחוּמְרָא. אֶלָּא הוּא מְטַמֵּא וְהֵם מְטַהֲרִין, הֵיכִי הָוֵי? וְהָא תַּנְיָא: חָכָם שֶׁטִּמֵּא — אֵין חֲבֵרוֹ רַשַּׁאי לְטַהֵר, אָסַר — אֵין חֲבֵרוֹ רַשַּׁאי לְהַתִּיר! קָסָבְרִי כִּי הֵיכִי דְּלָא נִגָּרְרוּ בָּתְרֵיהּ.
segments.en: The Gemara considers the details of this event: «Granted,» Ḥanina would rule an item «pure and» the Sages from Eretz Yisrael would rule it «impure;» they ruled «stringently. But» in a case where «he» ruled an item «impure and they» ruled it «pure, what are» the circumstances? How could they rule pure that which he ruled impure? «Was it not taught» in a baraita: «If a Sage» ruled an item «impure, his colleague is not permitted» to rule it «pure;» if he «prohibited» it, «his colleague may not permit» it? The Gemara explains: «They held» that they must do so in this case, «so that people would not be drawn after him;» due to the exigencies of the time they overturned his rulings.

moves.about: R' Yoḥanan's derivation from the juxtaposition of sota to terumot and tithes

moves.cueHe: אמר רב נחמן בר יצחק: ואם נתנן, סוף מתעשר
moves.summary: the converse from the same verse — one who does give the gifts grows rich
moves.about: extending R' Yoḥanan's reading of the same verse to the converse case — one who does give the gifts becomes wealthy

moves.cueHe: אמר רב הונא בר ברכיה משום רבי אלעזר הקפר
moves.summary: in R' Elazar HaKappar's name: one who involves Heaven in his distress has his livelihood doubled, from Job 22:25
moves.about: one who includes the name of Heaven in his distress has his livelihood doubled

moves.cueHe: רבי שמואל בר נחמני אמר: פרנסתו מעופפת לו כצפור
moves.summary: a rival reading of תועפות in the same verse — sustenance that flies to him like a bird
moves.about: reading תועפות from עוף — his sustenance flies to him like a bird

moves.cueHe: אמר רבי טבי אמר רבי יאשיה: כל המרפה עצמו מדברי תורה
moves.summary: R' Yoshiya, transmitted by R' Tavi: one lax in Torah has no strength on a day of adversity, from Proverbs 24:10
moves.about: one lax in Torah lacks strength on a day of adversity

moves.cueHe: אמר רב אמי בר מתנה אמר שמואל: ואפילו מצוה אחת
moves.summary: Shmuel, transmitted by Rav Ami bar Mattana, widens the rule to laxity in even one mitzva, from the unqualified התרפית
moves.about: that the rule holds even for laxity in a single mitzva

moves.cueHe: אמר רב ספרא: רבי אבהו הוה משתעי
moves.summary: opens the narrative: Ḥanina, R' Yehoshua's nephew, went to Babylonia and there intercalated years and fixed months
moves.about: the narrative of Ḥanina, nephew of R' Yehoshua, in Babylonia

moves.cueHe: שגרו אחריו שני תלמידי חכמים
moves.summary: two scholars are dispatched after him; he asks why they came, is told they came to study, and proclaims them eminent
moves.about: dispatching two Torah scholars after him to Babylonia

moves.cueHe: התחיל הוא מטמא והם מטהרים
moves.summary: they reverse every ruling he gives; he proclaims them worthless, and they answer that he cannot demolish what he built
moves.about: whether each item brought before the study hall is impure and prohibited, as Ḥanina ruled, or pure and permitted

moves.cueHe: אמר להם: מפני מה אני מטמא ואתם מטהרים
moves.summary: he asks why they systematically reverse him
moves.about: why they systematically reverse his rulings

moves.cueHe: אמרו לו: מפני שאתה מעבר שנים וקובע חדשים בחוץ לארץ
moves.summary: because he intercalates years and fixes months outside the Land
moves.about: that they oppose him because he intercalates years and fixes months outside Eretz Yisrael

moves.cueHe: אמר להם: והלא עקיבא בן יוסף, היה מעבר שנים
moves.summary: he presses them with R' Akiva, who also intercalated abroad
moves.about: that R' Akiva too intercalated years and fixed months outside the Land

moves.cueHe: אמרו לו: הנח רבי עקיבא
moves.summary: they dismiss the precedent he floated: R' Akiva left no equal behind in the Land
moves.about: that the R' Akiva precedent does not apply, since he left no equal behind in Eretz Yisrael

moves.cueHe: אמר להם: אף אני לא הנחתי כמותי בארץ ישראל
moves.summary: he claims the same condition for himself
moves.about: that he too left no one his equal in Eretz Yisrael, so the precedent holds

moves.cueHe: אמרו לו: גדיים שהנחת נעשו תישים בעלי קרנים
moves.summary: they defeat the claim he was standing on: those he left as kids are now horned goats greater than he, and they sent us with an ultimatum
moves.about: whether he really left no equal — the kids he left have grown into horned goats greater than he

moves.cueHe: ואמרו לאחינו שבגולה
moves.summary: the parallel ultimatum to Babylonian Jewry: back the ostracism or be treated as having no portion in the God of Israel
moves.about: the parallel message to Babylonian Jewry: back the ostracism or be treated as seceding from Israel

moves.cueHe: מיד געו כל העם בבכיה ואמרו: חס ושלום
moves.summary: the people weep and submit, and the plan to make Babylonia the center collapses
moves.about: whether Babylonia may become the center that fixes the calendar — the people weep and affirm their portion in the God of Israel

moves.cueHe: וכל כך למה?
moves.summary: why did the Sages of the Land press the matter so far?
moves.about: why the Sages of Eretz Yisrael went to such lengths to stop Ḥanina

moves.cueHe: משום שנאמר: ״כי מציון תצא תורה״
moves.summary: because Torah must go forth from Zion
moves.about: because Torah must go forth from Zion

moves.cueHe: בשלמא הוא מטהר, והם מטמאין — לחומרא
moves.summary: the lenient direction of the reversals is the problem: how could they permit what he prohibited?
moves.about: how the two scholars could rule pure what Ḥanina had ruled impure — leniency against a colleague's ruling, unlike the stringent direction which is unproblematic

moves.cueHe: והא תניא: חכם שטמא — אין חברו רשאי לטהר
moves.summary: a baraita forbids a colleague to permit what one Sage prohibited
moves.about: a baraita forbidding a colleague to permit what another Sage prohibited

moves.cueHe: קסברי כי היכי דלא נגררו בתריה
moves.summary: they held the hour required it, so people would not be drawn after him
moves.about: that the exigency of preventing people from being drawn after Ḥanina justified overturning his rulings
